title: 第17章 逃窜百里第18章 反杀再反杀
lines: 紫阳宗内，田管事正在与几个同门闲聊。
忽然间，他神情一紧，从怀中掏出一个玉牌。
这玉牌却已经裂开了数道裂痕，没等他再有什么动作，就彻底粉碎了。
“小弓！”
田管事一声惊呼，将周边几个同门的目光都吸引了过来。
“田师弟，可有要事？”
“哦，族内确实有事相召，在下先走一步了。”
说完，便匆匆离去。
那枚玉牌乃是田家给后辈子弟的一种感应符，一般两枚一对，若是捏碎其中的一枚，另一枚也会同时碎裂，同时会显示前者的方位。
“看距离，似乎是在紫阳矿区，莫非小弓跟踪李卓阳在矿区发现什么了？”
田管事念叨几句后，便出了紫阳宗，然后驾起一座飞舟，极速朝紫阳矿区飞去。
若是李卓阳在此，肯定能认出，这座飞舟，不正是百宝阁向自己推荐过的逍遥舟么？
密林中，李卓阳喘着粗气，站立了片刻。
这已经是李卓阳第二次杀人了，虽然心里还是砰砰直跳，但早已没有上次的那般剧烈。
刚才施展的巨灵剑法虽然没有将他的灵力抽空，却也着实耗费不少！
吃了一枚上次在大胡子那里得到的恢复灵力的丹药，打坐了片刻，才恢复得七七八八。
不过除了灵力损耗外，巨灵剑法还会对肉身带来一定的消耗，此时他仍然觉得双臂有些酸软。
这种情况用丹药和灵石都没用，只有龙江灵茶最有效！
将田持弓手中的寻踪镜及身上的储物袋捡走后，李卓阳正要翻找他身上还有没有什么值钱玩意，忽然瞥见了田持弓手中碎裂的玉符。
一种不安的情绪陡然升起！
虽不认识这种玉符，但李卓阳以前听祖父说过，修仙界很多传讯秘法都是通过玉符施展的。
于是他也顾不得翻找，随手一个火球术，就将田持弓给点燃了。
这时他下意识往紫阳宗方向一望，暗叫一声，糟糕！
太大意了，早该先离开此地，再打坐恢复灵气的。
李卓阳也无暇再暗自后悔，急忙架起了闪云梭，随便找了个方向飞去。
那逍遥舟速度极快，李卓阳前脚刚走，它后脚便落下。
“小弓！”田管事急忙施展一个水球术将火扑灭，但此时田持弓的躯体已经化为焦炭了！
“可恶！”田管事随手一挥，将田持弓的骨灰收入一个陶罐，然后坐上逍遥舟朝李卓阳追去。
李卓阳回首遥遥看到飞来的竟然是逍遥舟，心下不由得暗暗叫苦。
自己这闪云梭原本速度并不弱于逍遥舟，但刚才施展巨灵剑法，肉身有亏，竟然难以抵抗高空中凛冽的罡风，速度竟无法提升至最快。
眼看逍遥舟越来越快，李卓阳竟一时想不出什么破解的办法。
“杀了我田家的人，你还妄想能逃掉吗？”田管事站在逍遥舟上喊道，他已经看到前方逃窜的正是李卓阳。
李卓阳并不答话，只是尽力维持着闪云梭的遁形。
“李卓阳！你今日跑不了的，早点停下，我留你全尸，否则挫骨扬灰，永世不得入轮回！”
content_en:
In Ziyang Sect, Steward Tian was chatting with several fellow disciples.
Suddenly, he tensed up and took out a jade token from his arms.
However, the jade token had already cracked several times and was completely shattered before he could make any further moves.
"Little bow!"
Manager Tian exclaimed, attracting the attention of several fellow disciples around him.
"Junior Brother Tian, is there something important?"
"Oh, we are indeed called upon by something within the clan, so I'll take the first step."
After saying that, he left in a hurry.
That jade token is a kind of induction talisman given by the Tian family to the younger generations. Usually there are two in a pair. If one of them is crushed, the other one will also be shattered at the same time, and the direction of the former will be displayed at the same time.
"Looking at the distance, it seems to be in the Ziyang mining area. Could it be that Xiao Gong followed Li Zhuoyang and found something in the mining area?"
After Manager Tian muttered a few words, he left the Ziyang Sect, then drove a flying boat and flew towards the Ziyang Mining Area at high speed.
If Li Zhuoyang were here, he would definitely recognize that this flying boat was the Xiaoyao boat that Baibao Pavilion had recommended to him.
In the dense forest, Li Zhuoyang gasped and stood for a moment.
This is the second time Li Zhuoyang has killed someone. Although his heart is still pounding, it is not as violent as the last time.
Although the Giant Spirit Sword Technique he used just now did not drain away his spiritual power, it did consume a lot of it!
After taking a spiritual power-restoring elixir that I got from Big Beard last time, I meditated for a while and finally recovered.
However, in addition to the loss of spiritual power, the Giant Spirit Sword Technique also brought a certain amount of consumption to the physical body. At this time, he still felt that his arms were a little sore.
In this case, elixirs and spiritual stones are useless, only Longjiang Lingcha is the most effective!
After picking up the tracking mirror in Tian Chi Gong's hand and the storage bag on his body, Li Zhuoyang was about to look for anything valuable on him when he suddenly caught a glimpse of the broken jade talisman in Tian Chi Gong's hand.
An uneasy feeling suddenly arises!
Although he didn't recognize this kind of jade talisman, Li Zhuoyang had heard from his grandfather before that many secret communication techniques in the world of immortality were performed through jade talismans.
So he didn't care about rummaging around, and lit up Tian Chi's bow with a casual fireball spell.
At this time, he subconsciously looked in the direction of Ziyang Sect and secretly screamed, Oh no!
This is too careless. I should have left here long ago and meditated to restore my spiritual energy.
Li Zhuoyang had no time to regret secretly anymore, so he hurriedly set up the Shuangyun Shuttle and flew in a random direction.
The Xiaoyao boat was extremely fast. As soon as Li Zhuoyang stepped forward with his front legs, his back legs fell down.
"Little Gong!" Manager Tian hurriedly used a water ball technique to put out the fire, but at this time Tian Zhigong's body had been reduced to charcoal!
"Damn it!" Manager Tian waved his hand, put Tian Zhigong's ashes into a clay pot, and then got on the Xiaoyao boat and chased Li Zhuoyang.
Li Zhuoyang looked back in the distance and saw that the flying boat turned out to be Xiaoyao Zhou, and he couldn't help but secretly complain.
The original speed of my own Flashing Cloud Shuttle was not weaker than that of Xiaoyaozhou, but the physical body of the Giant Spirit Sword Technique just used was unable to withstand the biting wind in the sky, and the speed could not be increased to the fastest speed.
Seeing Xiaoyao Zhou getting faster and faster, Li Zhuoyang couldn't think of any way to solve it.
"You killed people from my Tian family, do you still think you can escape?" Steward Tian shouted from the Xiaoyao boat. He had already seen the person fleeing in front of him was Li Zhuoyang.
Li Zhuoyang did not answer, but tried his best to maintain the hiding form of Shan Yun Shuo.
"Li Zhuoyang! You can't run away today. Stop early and I'll keep your body intact. Otherwise, your bones will be shattered into ashes and you will never be reincarnated!"
title_en: Chapter 17 Escape for hundreds of miles Chapter 18 Counterattack and counterattack
